The foundation

Infrastructure expertise, applied directly.

Work with a principal engineer on the decisions that shape reliability, operability and the path to production.

  1. 01

    Architecture & migration

    Assess the platform, map the dependencies and compare container, virtualization and private-cloud options. You get architecture decisions, a phased migration plan, validation criteria and a rollback position.

  2. 02

    Private AI infrastructure

    Plan the compute, model serving, data access, identity and who operates it. Weigh local, enterprise-hosted and approved API options against what the workload actually needs, rather than a favourite model.

  3. 03

    SI technical enablement

    Support solution qualification, architecture reviews, workshops and proof-of-concept design, so partner engineers understand the trade-offs and can take delivery on themselves.

Putting AI to work

Four ways to connect AI to the business.

Light provides the control and execution foundation. The engagement adapts it to your data, identities, systems and approval steps.

  1. 01

    Enterprise AI Workflow Engineering

    Turn an existing process into an AI-assisted one: connect the authoritative data, define the reasoning task, structure the output and place the human checkpoints. It applies to finance, procurement, compliance, operations, support, sales operations, manufacturing, logistics, documents, reporting and IT.

  2. 02

    Governed Agent Operations

    Give each workload a durable identity, its own authorization, scoped tool access and defined limits on what it may change. Wire in human approval, policy checks, audit and after-the-fact reconciliation. The model proposes; the platform decides whether it runs.

  3. 03

    Service & Dependency Intelligence

    Build a service graph out of real evidence from repositories, configuration, runtime, infrastructure and documentation. Find dependencies and owners, spot changes, judge blast radius, prepare impact reports and support migrations and incident investigation.

  4. 04

    Custom Enterprise AI Solution

    Design a bounded solution around your own data and way of working when packaged software does not fit. Prepare the context, reason, produce structured output, validate it, and return the result to the existing workflow through a human or policy boundary.

Use cases

Built for the whole organization, not a pilot for six people.

The same controlled foundation carries very different workloads. What changes is the data and the approvals — not the way authority is enforced.

  1. 01

    Chatbot

    An assistant the entire company can ask, not a demo a handful of people try once. It answers from real internal information, and it knows which questions each person is allowed to have answered.

  2. 02

    RAG

    Answers drawn from your own documents, with a citation back to the source it used — so a reviewer can check the answer instead of having to trust it.

  3. 03

    GraphRAG

    Connects relationships across systems and documents, so the questions that need several hops can be answered at all: who depends on this, and what breaks if we change it.

An ongoing engagement

AI workflows need maintenance, not just a launch.

Review the corrections people made, the outputs they rejected, the escalations and exceptions, the false positives and negatives, how long things take, how the model performs, and what changed in the data and the business rules. AI can propose improvements, but every change is tested, reviewed and released as a controlled revision. Production policy never changes quietly.

Start with the systems you already run.

Bring the problem, the data you already have and the outcome you need. You do not need to choose a model or a framework first. Booking a demo prepares an email on your device — you decide whether to send it.
